observed_WT_WT_relative_SE.limits: Interval holds only for the specified relative floor SE, family51, reported cell counts and five tests; it is not a confidence interval for the floor.

fixed_floor.limits: Interval holds only for the specified relative floor SE, family51, reported cell counts and five tests; it is not a confidence interval for the floor.

joint_surface_definition: Largest common multiplier of all input SEs that retains rejection is z/tcrit(df); equality is the P=.05 boundary. Values <1 mean reported SEs already fail at that effective df. Variant-only inflation is also provided.
